title: First Spark
aim: Find the five-finger C position.
tip: Use right-hand fingers 1 2 3 4 5, then return. Keep your wrist loose.

title: Scale Surfer
aim: Connect an octave of C major.
tip: Right hand ascending: 1 2 3, thumb under, 1 2 3 4 5.

title: Chord Crew
aim: Hear a I-IV-V-I progression.
tip: Land all three notes together. Release fully before the next chord.

title: Arpeggio Orbit
aim: Turn a chord into a flowing line.
tip: Prepare the next finger before releasing the current note.

title: Minor Mood
aim: Hear Am-Dm-E-Am.
tip: Listen for the raised G-sharp in the E major chord.

title: Pocket Pulse
aim: Repeat without holding through the next beat.
tip: Lift between repeated notes; aim for equal space and sound.

title: Left Hand Lift
aim: Build left-hand independence.
tip: Use fingers 5 4 3 2 1 ascending, then reverse.

title: Star Trip
aim: Play the opening of Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star.
tip: Sing the phrase first. Hold its final notes for two beats.
credit: Traditional public-domain melody; MusicCoach pocket arrangement

title: C Five-Finger Flow
aim: Keep a relaxed five-finger shape.

title: Kick Pulse
aim: Place the kick on a steady pulse.
tip: Tap pad 1 with alternating hands. Release after every hit.

title: Backbeat Basics
aim: Alternate kick and snare.
tip: Count 1 2 3 4; snare answers the kick.

title: Hat Coordination
aim: Combine hats with kick and snare.
tip: Two highlighted pads mean a simultaneous hit.

title: First Tom Fill
aim: Travel across the toms.
tip: Keep the spacing even as your hands move.

title: Single Stroke Roll
aim: Practice the sticking: RLRLRLRL.
tip: Right hand on Snare, left on Rim. These are separate pad attacks, not a buzz-roll simulation. Keep doubles even.

title: Pocket Conversation
aim: Play a question and a tom-fill answer.
tip: Make the second half feel like a reply to the first.

title: Linear Call and Reply
aim: Connect a groove to a melodic drum phrase.
tip: Use the same pulse through the final fill.

title: Coordination Circuit
aim: Change from hats to ride to toms without losing time.
tip: Practice each four-hit cell, then link all four cells.

title: Linear Weave Study
aim: Move a sixteenth-note line across the kit.
tip: One pad per subdivision; keep each sound balanced.

title: Neon Walk - Original Song
aim: Perform a short A-fill-A drum arrangement.
tip: First 16 hits: groove. Next eight: fill. Return to the groove at the same tempo.

title: Midnight Circuit - Original Song
aim: Perform a linear verse, fill, and ride-cymbal chorus.
tip: Learn each section independently before the full Rhythm run.

title: Groove Builder
aim: Build four drum lanes and play them with a melodic sequence.
tip: Choose Kick, Snare, Hats or Clap. Lit outlines are the target; pads toggle steps 1-16. Play auditions the whole pattern. Match all four lanes to complete.
